scope: PPN preferred-frame alpha1 and alpha2 through the standard O(v^3) vector sector on the identical fixed action

external_source.guard: Use the sigma1=sigma2=0 expressions and simplify at a1=kappa=1,a2=0 before taking gamma1=-1 or lambda_HL=1 limits; do not substitute directly into apparent 0/0 forms.

target_cancellations.alpha1: at a1=kappa=1,a2=0 the first rational term simplifies to -4 and the second term to +4, so alpha1=0 before gamma1->-1
target_cancellations.alpha2: at a1=kappa=1 the numerator of Eq.(5.42) is identically zero as a polynomial in lambda_HL, so alpha2=0 for lambda_HL!=1 and has continuous value 0 at lambda_HL=1

non_claims: does not cover an independent incoming/homogeneous RTK scalar excitation excluded by the PPN branch
does not establish strong-field preferred-frame behavior, rotating compact objects or X_U->0 configurations
does not certify radiative stability, strong coupling, UV completion or cutoff
next_gate_if_pass: update the fixed-action PPN checkpoint: beta=gamma=1 and alpha1=alpha2=0 on the certified weak-field PPN branch, while retaining compact-object/radiative/UV gates as open
